newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Power Vogtle 1 nuke to shut Friday.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Power Vogtle 1 nuke to shut Friday.

text.p: Georgia Power Co's 1,162 megawatt (MW) Vogtle 1 nuclear unit is set to shut down Friday for about eight days of scheduled maintenance, the Southern Co unit said Thursday.
"We'll bring it down tomorrow for about eight and a half days. The outage has been scheduled for about five months. We have to repair a small leak in the main generator," a company spokesman said.
The adjacent Vogtle unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power, the spokesman said.
Both units are located in Waynesboro, Ga.
